one_sentence_story: Light in your bedroom at night leaks through closed eyelids to scramble your brain's master clock and raise depression risk by thirty percent, while bright outdoor morning light protects your mood.
so_what_for_you: Make your bedroom pitch dark at night—blackout curtains, TV off, paper books before bed—and step outside for fifteen minutes of real morning sky every day.
